basis: The dashboard is titled 'Smartphone Market Share in Europe' (r1 O1). The embedded slice labels give the current market_share values: Apple (60%), Samsung (12%), Xiaomi (10%), and Others (18%) (r1 O2–O5). The task rule requires selecting the brand with the highest current market_share, and 'Others' is an aggregate, not a selectable brand. Comparing the labeled brand values: Apple 60% > Samsung 12% > Xiaomi 10%. Although the visual wedge sizes appear inconsistent with the printed percentages, the printed labels are the explicit market_share values designated as the evidence source; they sum to 100% and directly identify the leader. Apple has the highest current market_share.
